content:
Then in turn the lord of men, Agamemnon, addressed him:
“I am glad, son of Laertes, to have heard your speech; for you have gone through everything in due measure and set it forth. I am willing to swear to these things, and my heart urges me; nor will I forswear myself before a god. But let Achilles remain where he is, eager though he is for war; and let all the rest of you stay together, until the gifts come from the hut and we cut trustworthy oaths. And to you yourself I give this charge and command: choose the best young men of all the Achaeans to carry the gifts from my ship, all that we pledged yesterday to give Achilles, and to bring the women. And let Talthybius quickly, throughout the broad host of the Achaeans, make ready a boar to cut in sacrifice to Zeus and to Helios.”
